title: Quasi-coherence of a specified finite scalar right adjoint
statement: Let f:X -> Y be a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme], put A=f_*O_X with the algebra structure f.c [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], and assume D(O_Y) and D(A) exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let rho be the specified right derived scalar restriction and let rhoR:D(O_Y) -> D(A) carry a specified adjunction rho ⊣ rhoR. For K in D_QCoh(Y) with a lower cohomological bound, rhoR(K) has quasi-coherent cohomology over A in every degree, i.e. lies in directImageAlgebraDerivedQCohProperty f. No geometric right adjoint or geometric counit comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0AX2, first assertion, with Tag 0BV0 scalar adjunction

proof.text: Construct the direct-image algebra B as Under.mk f.c. To meet the local-derived-category assumption of finite_pushforward_derivedHom_qcoherent in the existing morphism universe wY, prove that module pushforward from Over U is faithful: any V over U is isomorphic to (Over.star U).obj V.left, since V is contained in U. Equality of pushed-forward maps thus gives equality on V by naturality. Compose this faithful functor with DerivedCategory.singleFunctor at zero. Mathlib locallySmall_of_faithful gives local smallness in wY, and HasDerivedCategory.ofHasKInjectiveResolutions constructs the required local derived categories, using SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian for the over site.

Apply finite_pushforward_derivedHom_qcoherent to B with rfl and the given K and lower bound. Obtain hB, quasi-coherence of the constructed algebra-valued derived Hom after scalar restriction in every cohomology degree, and the other unused membership conclusions. Apply sheafAlgebraDerivedHom_adjunction to this same B and hB, and use Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq with adjA to obtain an isomorphism from rhoR(K) to the constructed derived Hom value.

For each integer n, apply quasiCoherent_iff_restrictScalars to the nth cohomology module using hB, obtaining quasi-coherence over B from the underlying O_Y-module property. Map the inverse of the right-adjoint isomorphism through the nth homology functor and transport quasi-coherence using ObjectProperty.prop_of_iso. The underlying B ring sheaf equals moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f) definitionally; the quasi-coherence predicates require the cited scalar-restriction equivalence, not merely definitional unfolding.

theorem finite_scalar_right_adjoint_qcoh {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    (ρR : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))))
    (adjA : (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
          (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
          ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩).rightDerivedFunctor ⊣ ρR)
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (hK : ∃ n : ℤ, K.obj.IsGE n) :
    directImageAlgebraDerivedQCohProperty f (ρR.obj K.obj)
